description.en: Runs the full "avatar obtained/attached" presentation: fades out the BGM, plays a jingle, shows the message (with the character and avatar substituted into it), and — if _atch is set — actually attaches the avatar to the character's party handle (temporarily unlocking it if needed, then restoring or forcing the lock afterwards), before restoring the BGM. The general engine behind RunAttachAvatar/RunAttachAvatarOnlyMsg.
Character ID the avatar belongs to, substituted into the message.
Avatar ID, substituted into the message.
BGM fade-out duration in frames before the sequence.
Number of frames to wait after the BGM fade before starting.
Jingle sound event ID to play.
Message substitution slot index for the character/avatar.
Whether to actually attach the avatar (false shows the message only, without attaching).
Whether to lock the avatar in place after attaching it.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Attach and lock an avatar with the standard presentation (as RunAttachAvatar does internally)
RunAttachAvatarEx("para_cp0005", "ck0025", 30, 30, "J_07", 0, "sysmes-Avatar-00001", true, true);
